name: Candy Coated BITEZ Gummies 500mg Baggiez | Delta-9 | Watermelon Punch
description: Watermelon Punch tastes like the party cooler got taken over by the candy bowl. Juicy watermelon lays down a sweet, refreshing base while a rush of mixed fruit punch brings louder, tangier candy notes into the mix. The outside gets buried in tiny, colorful crunchy candies, creating a crackly first bite before you hit two soft, chewy gummy layers underneath with 50mg of Delta-9 THC in each.
